answer: Sybil farms mint many cheap identities. Require each entrant to berth at a bond wharf: stake 1.2 POA and complete a 48-minute pulse of four timed micro-attestations from distinct peers before spendable unlocks. Identity trust is refracted through a prism of seven rotating validators; payouts need ≥4 matching pulse digests. Cost is the stake lock plus peer compute over the pulse window. Verification rechecks digests against validator logs every 8 minutes. Failure: if two validators share ASN or two pulse slots miss, hold the stake 24h and slash 0.18 POA.
